messages:
andrea: Heads-up: canary hit stability issue after toggling AWQ group_size from 32->64 on rdb-dedicated-3, p99 latency spiked, a few requests aborted. Repro steps below.
kevin: oh no, any logs?
andrea: short logs: `serving: token-drop: 0.6%`, `grpc-reset` printed a few times. p99 from 120ms -> 890ms. Happens under sustained batch traffic (~120 rps).
hannah: Did we change act quant params too?
andrea: yes group_size=64, act_quant=2, same commit also enabled 'prefer_fp16_kv' but we rolled that back. config snippet:
```
awq:
  group_size: 64
  act_quant: 2
  kv_mode: auto
```
kevin: Can you run `./tools/serve-local --model llm-13b-awq --group 64 --trace` and paste trace?
andrea: running now, attaching tail:
```
[trace] step 457: kv-cache-miss 0.12, batch_merge_wait=24ms
[trace] step 461: upstream-grpc retry
```
hannah: @andrea did we run evals? accuracy delta?
andrea: Eval on eval-suite-2025: bleu drop 0.4, rouge-L -1.9 on conversational set vs group=32 baseline. So quality got worse in some prompts.
kevin: That suggests act quant interacts with group size; could be accumulator overflow/scale mismatch. Try group_size=48 or 56?
andrea: I scheduled a canary swap to group=48 on two nodes. Going to monitor.
deploy-bot: Canary update started: canary-id=canary-2023-11-25-1719954321
sre-oncall: monitoring p95/p99 and error-rate. alert if p99>500ms or error_rate>0.2%
andrea: After swap to 48: p99 back to 130ms, errors down. Re-running evals, will post numbers.
hannah: If 48 stabilizes and quality is similar to 32, consider making group_size per-model knob in rollout policy.
andrea: Agree. Next steps: 1) run a sweep of group_size [32,40,48,56,64] with act_quant [1,2]; 2) add guardrail to auto-fallback to lower group on p99 spike; 3) add assertion to binops in AWQ kernel for scale overflow.
kevin: Also add a perf metric: 'kv-merge-latency' to console so we can trace early.
andrea: :thumbsup: will open PR and a small incident note.
